app.name: Task Manager
app.tagline: Projects and tasks, with Claude Code alongside

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Access is limited to the owner and invited people.

errors.not_invited: Your GitHub account has no access. Ask the owner to invite you to a project.
errors.oauth: GitHub sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.

projects.title: Projects
projects.emptyHint: Create your first project to start organising tasks.

projectForm.name: Name
projectForm.keyHint: 2–6 letters/digits (e.g. RNK). Cannot be changed later.
projectForm.conflict: Someone else (or Claude) changed this project. The current data has been loaded; review it and save again.
projectForm.inboxLocked: The Inbox slug cannot be changed and it cannot be archived.
projectForm.invalidSlug: Use only lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.

project.notesPlaceholder: Markdown notes: decisions, context — NOT credentials (use the vault)…
project.notesConflict: The notes changed while you were editing (maybe Claude). They have been reloaded; your text is still in the editor so you can merge it.
project.notFoundHint: It does not exist or you do not have access.

projectSettings.title: Project settings
projectSettings.deleteBody: The project and all its tasks will be hidden. This cannot be undone from the app.
projectSettings.forbidden: Only the owner can change this project's settings.

links.label: Label
links.invalid: Check the links: each one needs a label and an http(s) URL.

members.description: Invite GitHub users. Viewers can only read; commenters can also comment. Invited people can never edit.
members.revokeBody: They will lose access to this project immediately.
members.empty: Nobody else has access to this project.
members.invalidLogin: Enter a valid GitHub username (letters, numbers and dashes, max 39).

shareLinks.description: Anyone with the link can see the project and its tasks read-only (no notes, client or comments).
shareLinks.label: Label
shareLinks.revokeBody: Anyone who has it will no longer be able to open it.

vault.title: Vault
vault.description: Project accounts and credentials. Secrets are stored encrypted and every access is logged.
vault.emptyHint: Store access to hosting, dashboards, APIs…
vault.secretKeep: Leave empty to keep the current secret.
vault.shareWarning: Claude will be able to read this secret through MCP, but only with a token that has “Allow secrets”. Every read is logged. Turn it on only if a task needs it.
vault.deleteBody: The encrypted secret will be deleted too.
vault.forbidden: Only the owner can see the vault.

tokens.title: API tokens (MCP)
tokens.description: Each connected repo uses a personal token to talk to the MCP server. The token is shown only once.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.allowSecretsHelp: Allows reading secrets flagged “Share with Claude”.
tokens.createdWarning: Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
tokens.revokeBody: Claude sessions using it will stop working.
tokens.forbidden: Only the owner can manage tokens.
tokens.invalidName: Enter a name for the token (max 60 characters).

connect.title: Connect a repository
connect.scriptHelp: From the Task Manager folder. It asks for the token (hidden), writes the repo's .mcp.json and adds it to its .gitignore.
connect.jsonHelp: Save it at the repo root and do not commit it (it contains the token).

public.notFoundHint: The link does not exist or has been revoked.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.conflict: Someone changed this data while you were editing. Reload and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.pageNotFoundHint: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

reasons.dependency_cycle: That dependency would create a cycle (the tasks would end up blocking each other).
reasons.reserved_slug: That slug is reserved (inbox, all). Choose another one.
reasons.reserved_key: That key is reserved. Choose another one.
reasons.slug_taken: Another project already uses that slug.
reasons.slug_deleted: That slug is still reserved by a deleted project. Choose another one.
reasons.key_taken: Another project already uses that key.
reasons.key_deleted: That key is still reserved by a deleted project. Choose another one.
reasons.project_exists: A project with that slug or key already exists.
reasons.slug_underivable: A slug cannot be derived from the name: type one.
reasons.inbox_slug: The Inbox slug cannot be changed.
reasons.owner_invite: You are the owner: you already have full access and do not need an invitation.
reasons.already_member: That user already has access to this project.
reasons.token_name_taken: You already have a token with that name.
reasons.secret_not_shared: This secret is not shared with Claude.
reasons.vault_unavailable: The vault is unavailable: check the server encryption key (NUXT_VAULT_KEY).
reasons.not_a_member: That person is not an active member of this project.
